abstract: We extend BLP’s aggregate discrete-choice model of product differentiation to create more flexibility in the price functional form. We apply a Box-Cox specification, which relaxes the typical unit demand assumption and creates flexibility on demand curvature. The model provides a unifying framework for mixed logit and mixed CES models, while remaining computationally tractable. We provide an illustrative application to the ready-to-eat cereals market. This shows that the cross-sectional relation between price elasticities and average prices per product is more in line with descriptive elasticity patterns, and that substitution between product pairs may be affected to some extent.
title: Estimating Substitution Patterns and Demand Curvature in Discrete-Choice Models of Product Differentiation
title_zh: 估计产品差异化离散选择模型中的替代模式与需求曲率

abstract: In this paper, we propose a statistical model to characterize the null hypothesis of the random product size distribution for multi-product exporters. It serves as a benchmark to test the empirical facts and model predictions. We ask which stylized facts that characterize multi-product exporters and motivate such theories as core competencies, productivity being a driver of both scope and scale, and economies of scope, among others, are spurious, and which are informative. The benchmark model also provides alternative moments to test the validity of these theories.
title: Multi-Product Exporters: Verifying Stylized Facts
title_zh: 多产品出口商：验证典型事实

abstract: This study examines how date‐labeling formats and information disclosure shape Chinese online consumers' food‐waste behavior, using a vignette experiment with 1122 respondents analyzed across three products (fresh milk, chips, nuts). The longer a product has been past its labeled date, the less willing consumers are to consume it: relative to long‐expired items, just‐expired milk, chips, and nuts are 41%, 126%, and 93% more likely to be consumed, respectively. For milk, a direct date label lowers the odds of consumption by 27% relative to an indirect label (odds ratio = 0.73, p p = 0.007) to a nonsignificant 0.023 ( p = 0.778)). Therefore, we recommend adding explanatory text on packaging and continuously carrying out consumer education and awareness campaigns to help consumers distinguish between “end of guaranteed quality” and “food safety boundary.” In addition, these efforts should be complemented by technologies that extend the shelf life of perishable products.
abstract_zh: 本研究考察了日期标签格式与信息披露如何影响中国线上消费者的食物浪费行为，采用情境实验法，对1122名受访者进行了分析，涵盖三种产品（鲜牛奶、薯片、坚果）。产品超过标注日期的時間越长，消费者食用意愿越低：相对于过期较久的食品，刚过期的牛奶、薯片和坚果被食用的可能性分别高出41%、126%和93%。对于牛奶而言，与间接日期标签相比，直接日期标签使食用几率降低27%（比值比=0.73，p p=0.007）至不显著的0.023（p=0.778）。因此，我们建议在包装上增加说明性文字，并持续开展消费者教育与意识宣传活动，帮助消费者区分“保证质量截止期”与“食品安全边界”。此外，这些努力还应辅以延长易腐产品保质期的技术。
china_relevance_reason: 研究对象为中国线上消费者，使用1122名中国受访者的实验数据，直接涉及中国人群的食品浪费行为。
title: Overcoming Misconceptions: Enhancing Consumer Understanding of Date Labels to Reduce Food Waste
title_zh: 消除误解：提升消费者对日期标签的理解以减少食物浪费

abstract: This paper examines the effects of logistics performance on international trade. A country's logistics capacity is measured by the Logistics Performance Index ( LPI ), compiled by the World Bank, which gives comparable country‐level data for 166 countries in six waves. We use the LPI in different gravity model approaches, comparing the results from fixed effects Poisson regressions, relative gravity, and a Probit estimation. We construct a bilateral trade dataset with 27,638 bilateral trade relationships from CEPIIs trade database. The results of all used approaches indicate sizable and significant positive effects of logistics performance on international trade. While positive and significant for all regions, the size of logistics effect on trade differs across the regions. The findings give relevant policy implications and stress the need to improve the logistics system and associated performance to encourage trade.
abstract_zh: 本文考察了物流绩效对国际贸易的影响。一个国家的物流能力由世界银行编制的物流绩效指数（LPI）衡量，该指数提供了166个国家在六轮调查中可比较的国家层面数据。我们在不同的引力模型方法中使用LPI，比较固定效应泊松回归、相对引力以及Probit估计的结果。我们构建了一个包含来自CEPII贸易数据库的27,638个双边贸易关系的双边贸易数据集。所有所用方法的结果均表明，物流绩效对国际贸易具有可观且显著的正向影响。尽管对所有地区而言均为正向且显著，但物流对贸易影响的规模因地区而异。这些发现提供了相关的政策启示，并强调了改善物流系统及相关绩效以促进贸易的必要性。
title: Estimating the Effects of Logistics Performance on Trade: Evidence From Different Gravity Model Approaches
title_zh: 评估物流绩效对贸易的影响：来自不同引力模型方法的证据

abstract: Interventions to reduce consumption of sugar‐sweetened beverages have been a popular topic of research in agricultural economics and food policy in recent years. While most empirical attention has focused on excise taxation and quasi‐experimental evaluation of implemented taxes, less is known about the magnitude of behavioural responses to information‐based interventions under incentive‐compatible conditions. We report results from an incentivised laboratory experiment conducted in New Zealand in which participants made repeated beverage purchase decisions with real economic consequences. After five purchase rounds across multiple price regimes, subjects were exposed to a salient health‐information intervention and then repeated the same decisions. The information intervention reduced the unconditional quantity purchased by approximately 25% (except for one sugar‐free variant). Comparing these effects to experimentally induced price changes implies a tax‐equivalent magnitude similar to a specific excise of roughly 50 cents per litre; given the experimental design, this should be interpreted as an upper‐bound estimate of the immediate response to a highly salient information intervention under laboratory conditions.
abstract_zh: 近年来，减少含糖饮料消费的干预措施一直是农业经济学和食品政策研究的热门话题。尽管大多数实证研究关注的是消费税以及对已实施税收的准实验评估，但人们对在激励相容条件下基于信息的干预措施所引发行为反应的幅度知之甚少。我们报告了在新西兰开展的一项激励性实验室实验结果，参与者在实验中做出具有真实经济后果的重复饮料购买决策。在经历多个价格机制下的五轮购买后，受试者接受了一项显著的健康信息干预，随后重复了相同的决策。该信息干预使无条件购买量减少了约25%（一种无糖变体除外）。将这些效应与实验诱导的价格变化进行比较，意味着其税收等价幅度类似于每升约50美分的从量消费税；鉴于实验设计，这应被解释为在实验室条件下对高度显著的信息干预即时反应的上限估计。
journal: Australian Journal of Agricultural and Resource Economics
title: The Tax‐Equivalent Effect of Information: Evidence From an Incentivised Laboratory Experiment on Sugary Drinks
title_zh: 信息的税收等价效应：来自含糖饮料激励实验室实验的证据

abstract: Biosolids are a solid byproduct of municipal wastewater treatment systems. Conventionally, because of their nutrient and carbon content, most biosolids have been applied to agricultural lands in Australia. However, growing concerns over methane emissions, ongoing management and transportation costs and contaminants of emerging concern, such as per‐ and polyfluoroalkyl substances (PFAS) and microplastics, are calling conventional approaches into question. Water utilities are therefore exploring alternative options and new infrastructure investments to manage biosolids, considering wide‐ranging financial, environmental and social outcomes. We survey 3135 Australian residents and use an anchored best–worst scaling experiment to elicit public preferences for alternative biosolids management strategies. Results suggest the public is generally supportive of all biosolids management approaches, but that the reuse of biosolids to build roads, to create energy and for construction is most preferred. Using latent class analysis, we also uncover significant preference heterogeneity and some polarisation, especially for the use of biosolids in the food system. Together, our results emphasise the importance of developing effective soft infrastructure, like policy and engagement processes, to build public confidence and support the implementation of new hard infrastructure to improve biosolids management outcomes.
abstract_zh: 生物固体是市政污水处理系统的一种固体副产物。传统上，由于其含有养分和碳，澳大利亚大多数生物固体被施用于农业用地。然而，对甲烷排放、持续的管理与运输成本以及新出现的关注污染物（如全氟和多氟烷基物质（PFAS）和微塑料）日益增长的担忧，正使传统方法受到质疑。因此，水务机构正在探索替代方案和新的基础设施投资来管理生物固体，并综合考虑广泛的财务、环境和社会结果。我们调查了3135名澳大利亚居民，并采用锚定最佳-最差量表实验来引出公众对替代生物固体管理策略的偏好。结果表明，公众总体上支持所有生物固体管理方法，但最偏好将生物固体再利用于修建道路、生产能源和用于建筑。通过潜在类别分析，我们还发现了显著的偏好异质性以及一定程度的极化，尤其是在将生物固体用于食品系统方面。总之，我们的结果强调了制定有效的软基础设施（如政策和参与流程）的重要性，以建立公众信心并支持实施新的硬基础设施，从而改善生物固体管理结果。
journal: Australian Journal of Agricultural and Resource Economics
title: What Should We Do With Sewage Sludge? Public Preferences for Biosolids Management in Australia
title_zh: 我们应该如何处理污水污泥？澳大利亚公众对生物固体管理的偏好

abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are lowering the barriers to entry for working with previously hard-to-use data sources that once required strong data science skills, such as handwritten ledgers, text, images, or sound recordings. This guide provides an introduction for researchers who are new to LLMs. It sets out a step-by-step workflow for turning a research idea into working code, data, theoretical models, or replication packages. It then works through the decisions a practitioner faces in sequence, beginning with whether an LLM is the right tool and whether the data are allowed to be sent to one, then how to select models, write prompts, manage context limits, and control costs, and finally how to validate, reproduce, document, and correct LLM-generated measures in regression settings. A review of recent research shows how these tools already extract, link, harmonize, and classify historical data at scale. Four worked examples with replication files illustrate the use of LLMs. They classify emotions in paintings, link census records without names, measure newspaper salience and sentiment around the 1882 Chinese Exclusion Act, and score the emotional delivery of Franklin D. Roosevelt’s wartime speeches. The guide also condenses the workflow, best-practice recommendations, and preparation of replication packages into summary tables and checklists to aid applied economists.
abstract_zh: 大语言模型（LLMs）正在降低使用以往难以获取的数据源的门槛，这些数据源过去需要很强的数据科学技能，例如手写账簿、文本、图像或录音。本指南为初次接触LLMs的研究人员提供入门介绍。它提出了一套分步工作流程，用于将研究想法转化为可运行的代码、数据、理论模型或复制包。随后，它依次梳理实践者所面临的决策，首先是大语言模型是否是合适的工具，以及数据是否被允许发送给大语言模型；然后是如何选择模型、撰写提示词、管理上下文限制并控制成本；最后是如何在回归设定中验证、复现、记录并修正由大语言模型生成的测量指标。对近期研究的综述表明，这些工具已经能够大规模地提取、链接、协调和分类历史数据。四个带有复制文件的实操示例展示了LLMs的使用。它们对绘画中的情绪进行分类，在没有姓名的情况下链接人口普查记录，测量围绕1882年《排华法案》的报纸显著性与情感，并对富兰克林·D·罗斯福战时演讲的情感表达进行评分。本指南还将该工作流程、最佳实践建议以及复制包的准备浓缩为汇总表和清单，以帮助应用经济学家。
china_relevance_reason: 该文是经济史中使用大语言模型的方法指南，核心是方法论与工作流程；唯一中国相关表述是1882年《排华法案》的报纸显著性案例，属于美国历史背景，并非以中国为研究对象。
title: A practitioner’s guide to using large language models and generative AI in economic history
title_zh: 经济史研究中运用大型语言模型与生成式AI的实践指南

abstract: This note revisits the two-player, two-period model of conflict and natural-resource use in Rohner (2006). The interior reaction functions reported in that model are based on a stationary point that is not a payoff maximum: under the economically relevant parameter restrictions, the second derivative of payoff with respect to own extraction is positive. Because extraction is bounded, best responses are instead determined by boundary payoff comparisons. I derive the resulting best-response correspondence and characterize the symmetric pure-strategy equilibria of the original model. Under Rohner’s numerical calibration, zero current extraction is a strict best response in both resource cases, yielding a unique Nash equilibrium at zero extraction. The renewable-resource case therefore implies underexploitation, whereas the negative-externality case implies efficient conservation rather than overexploitation.
abstract_zh: 本文重新审视了Rohner（2006）中关于冲突与自然资源使用的两人两期模型。该模型所报告的内部反应函数基于一个并非收益最大值的驻点：在经济上相关的参数限制下，收益对自身开采量的二阶导数为正。由于开采量有界，最佳反应转而由边界收益比较决定。我推导了由此得到的最佳反应对应，并刻画了原模型的对称纯策略均衡。在Rohner的数值校准下，两种资源情形中零当期开采都是严格最佳反应，从而得到零开采处的唯一纳什均衡。因此，可再生资源情形意味着开采不足，而负外部性情形则意味着有效保护，而非过度开采。
title: Boundary Equilibria in Conflict and Natural-Resource Exploitation: A Comment on Rohner (2006)
title_zh: 冲突与自然资源开发中的边界均衡：对Rohner（2006）的评论

abstract: Using a survey and a pre-registered experiment, we provide evidence on the role of hype and social preferences on crypto investing. Our survey shows that crypto investors are more likely to be influenced by hype and exhibit lower social preferences. Our experiment helps us establish causal relationships: the hype treatment (i.e., information on the number of investors becoming millionaires daily through Bitcoin investing) increases the amount invested in crypto, with evidence consistent with higher expected returns playing a role, whereas the social treatments (i.e., information on crypto’s environmental impact and association with illegal activities) reduce the investment amount without altering financial expectations. Overall, our study helps to understand what encourages and hampers crypto investing.
abstract_zh: 通过一项调查和一项预注册实验，我们提供了关于炒作和社会偏好对加密货币投资作用的证据。我们的调查表明，加密货币投资者更易受炒作影响，并表现出较低的社会偏好。我们的实验有助于我们建立因果关系：炒作处理（即关于每日通过比特币投资成为百万富翁的投资者数量的信息）增加了加密货币的投资金额，且有证据表明这与更高的预期回报发挥作用相一致；而社会处理（即关于加密货币环境影响及与非法活动关联的信息）则减少了投资金额，但未改变财务预期。总体而言，我们的研究有助于理解是什么鼓励和阻碍了加密货币投资。
journal: Journal of Economic Behavior and Organization
source_issue: Journal of Economic Behavior & Organization, Volume 251
title: The Effects of Hype and Social Preferences on Crypto Investing
title_zh: 炒作与社会偏好对加密货币投资的影响

abstract: Abstract Largesse design is a positive theory of what happens when players in a game, who have a limited willingness to sacrifice for the common good, can coordinate on a welfare-optimal solution. This theory provides an alternative to psychological theories in explaining why players engage in costly punishments and rewards. It also says that players will engage in other low-cost methods of encouraging pro-social behavior, for example, through reputation effects. In this paper, I study the properties and comparative statics of the largesse design problem. Despite a lack of concavity in the maximization problem, solutions are unique and continuous except on a lower-dimensional bifurcation set. In examples, I study these bifurcations, in which a small change in the parameters can lead to a large change in behavior or welfare.
abstract_zh: 慷慨设计是一种实证理论，用以说明当博弈参与者为共同利益做出牺牲的意愿有限时，他们如何能够协调达成福利最优解。该理论为解释参与者为何进行代价高昂的惩罚与奖励提供了一种替代心理学理论的视角。它还指出，参与者会采用其他低成本方法来鼓励亲社会行为，例如通过声誉效应。本文研究慷慨设计问题的性质与比较静态。尽管最大化问题缺乏凹性，其解仍是唯一的，并且除在一个低维分岔集上之外是连续的。在示例中，我研究了这些分岔，其中参数的微小变化可能导致行为或福利的巨大变化。
publisher: Springer Science and Business Media LLC
title: The Largesse design problem
title_zh: 慷慨设计问题

abstract: Renewable energy transitions change rather than remove the geopolitical dimensions of energy systems. In recent years, geopolitical fragmentation, strategic rivalry, and geoeconomic insecurity have increased the importance of security, resilience, and strategic dependence within Europe's energy transition. Against this background, this study examines how geopolitical risk exposure is associated with four observable transition adjustment outcomes across 25 EU member states from 2001 to 2023: external energy dependence, domestic renewable energy capacity, economic globalization, and climate-significant public investment. Geopolitical risk exposure was measured by interacting the annual Global Geopolitical Risk Index with countries' geographical proximity to Russia, allowing the empirical models to incorporate both country and year fixed effects. The empirical analysis combined conventional two-way fixed-effects estimation with double machine learning (DML), alternative exposure specifications, robustness analyses, moderation analyses, and heterogeneity analyses. The results showed that greater geopolitical risk exposure is associated with lower external energy dependence, greater domestic renewable energy capacity, and lower economic globalization, while its relationship with climate-significant public investment is statistically insignificant. The moderating and heterogeneity analyses further indicated that these relationships vary with countries' energy-consumption levels, innovation capability, industrial structure, Russian energy dependence, and institutional capacity. Overall, the findings indicate selective rather than uniform adjustment across Europe's energy transition.
abstract_zh: 可再生能源转型改变而非消除能源体系的地缘政治维度。近年来，地缘政治碎片化、战略竞争和地缘经济不安全的加剧，提升了安全、韧性和战略依赖在欧洲能源转型中的重要性。在此背景下，本研究考察2001年至2023年间25个欧盟成员国中，地缘政治风险暴露如何与四项可观测的转型调整结果相关联：外部能源依赖、国内可再生能源产能、经济全球化以及具有气候意义的公共投资。地缘政治风险暴露的测量方式为：将年度全球地缘政治风险指数与各国相对于俄罗斯的地理邻近性进行交互，从而使实证模型能够同时纳入国家固定效应和年份固定效应。实证分析将传统的双向固定效应估计与双重机器学习（DML）、替代性暴露设定、稳健性分析、调节分析和异质性分析相结合。结果表明，更高的地缘政治风险暴露与更低的外部能源依赖、更高的国内可再生能源产能以及更低的经济全球化水平相关联，而其与具有气候意义的公共投资之间的关系在统计上不显著。调节分析和异质性分析进一步表明，这些关系随各国的能源消费水平、创新能力、产业结构、对俄罗斯能源的依赖以及制度能力而变化。总体而言，研究结果表明，欧洲能源转型中的调整是选择性的，而非统一的。
title: The geopoliticization of Europe's energy transition: Geopolitical risk and selective transition adjustment across EU member states
title_zh: 欧洲能源转型的地缘政治化：地缘政治风险与欧盟成员国间的选择性转型调整

abstract: Cities increasingly rely on infrastructure investment and streetscape upgrading to improve urban conditions, yet how macro-scale infrastructure inequality and micro-scale street environments relate to different dimensions of urban experience remains insufficiently understood. This study develops a geospatial learning framework to examine their associations with two distinct outcomes across Chinese cities: recorded crime rates and perceived wealth. The framework combines network-based accessibility measures for infrastructure systems, within-city inequality indicators, street-view-derived environmental and perceptual measures, and interpretable machine-learning analysis. The results reveal divergent spatial patterns. Recorded crime rates are most strongly associated with inequalities in telecommunications and educational infrastructure accessibility, together with selected streetscape characteristics. Telecommunications accessibility inequality shows a strong positive association with recorded crime rates, with its contribution becoming more pronounced at higher levels of inequality. By contrast, perceived wealth is explained predominantly by directly visible streetscape characteristics, particularly greenness, complexity, and openness, while infrastructure, socioeconomic, and security-governance variables contribute less. These findings show that recorded crime and perceived wealth capture different dimensions of the urban environment: the former is more closely associated with infrastructure accessibility inequality and selected street conditions, whereas the latter is primarily structured by visual streetscape cues. This distinction highlights the need to consider both spatial inequality and street-level environmental quality in evaluating urban conditions. For urban policy, strategies focused on beautification alone may overlook underlying vulnerabilities, while more equitable infrastructure provision may better address persistent spatial disparities in recorded crime rates.
abstract_zh: 城市日益依赖基础设施投资和街景升级来改善城市状况，但宏观尺度基础设施不平等与微观尺度街道环境如何与城市体验的不同维度相关联，仍缺乏充分理解。本研究构建了一个地理空间学习框架，以考察其与中国城市中两类不同结果之间的关联：记录在案的犯罪率和感知财富。该框架结合了基于网络的基础设施系统可达性测度、城市内部不平等指标、街景衍生的环境与感知测度，以及可解释机器学习分析。结果揭示了分异的空间格局。记录在案的犯罪率与电信和教育基础设施可达性不平等以及部分街景特征关联最为强烈。电信可达性不平等与记录在案的犯罪率呈强正相关，且其贡献在不平等程度较高时更为显著。相比之下，感知财富主要由直接可见的街景特征解释，尤其是绿度、复杂性和开放度，而基础设施、社会经济和安全治理变量的贡献较小。这些发现表明，记录在案的犯罪率和感知财富捕捉了城市环境的不同维度：前者与基础设施可达性不平等及部分街道条件关联更紧密，而后者主要由视觉街景线索所塑造。这一区分凸显了在评估城市状况时需同时考虑空间不平等和街道层面环境质量。就城市政策而言，仅聚焦于美化的策略可能忽视潜在脆弱性，而更公平的基础设施供给可能更有助于应对记录在案犯罪率中持续存在的空间差异。
china_relevance_reason: 标题、摘要或元数据包含中国相关关键词
title: Seeing prosperity, confronting crime: Infrastructure inequality and perceived wealth in Chinese cities
title_zh: 见繁荣，直面犯罪：中国城市中的基础设施不平等与感知财富

abstract: In this paper, we study the causal relationship between trade exposure and individual income risk, with emphasis on the role of human capital. We use a rich worker-level longitudinal dataset from Germany spanning the period 1976-2012, and find industry trade exposure to be causally related to income risk: Imports increase risk and exports decrease risk in an economically significant manner. Importantly, there is a complex interplay between human capital and the linkage between trade and risk: On average, individuals with higher levels of industry- or occupation-specific human capital experience lower risk. However, an increase in industry net imports increases risk more for workers with higher levels of industry tenure. Although net imports are also associated with declines in the mean income of these workers, the estimated effect on income levels is economically small. Our welfare framework, which jointly considers both mean income and income risk, shows that the welfare consequences of trade exposure are quantitatively dominated by the risk channel.
abstract_zh: 本文研究贸易暴露与个人收入风险之间的因果关系，重点关注人力资本的作用。我们使用来自德国1976—2012年间的丰富劳动者层面纵向数据集，发现行业贸易暴露与收入风险存在因果关系：进口以经济上显著的方式增加风险，出口则降低风险。重要的是，人力资本与贸易和风险之间的联系之间存在复杂的相互作用：平均而言，拥有更高行业专用性或职业专用性人力资本的个体经历更低的风险。然而，行业净进口的增加对行业任期更长的劳动者而言会带来更大的风险上升。尽管净进口也与这些劳动者平均收入的下降相关，但对收入水平的估计影响在经济上较小。我们的福利框架同时考虑平均收入和收入风险，表明贸易暴露的福利后果在数量上由风险渠道主导。
journal: Journal of the European Economic Association
title: Trade, Human Capital, and Income Risk,
title_zh: 贸易、人力资本与收入风险

abstract: Using a proprietary data set that documents corporate bond issuances in China, we find that bond regulators’ comment letters (CLs) on issuers’ public disclosures generally target opaque firms and reduce bond issuance success. We also find, however, that connected investors—financial institutions with prior business relationships with the issuers—purchase a relatively larger share of bond issuances from CL recipients than from non-CL recipients, and this greater participation contributes to overpricing. Further analysis shows that connected investors support CL recipients because they possess superior private information and obtain private benefits from their connections. This paper was accepted by Ranjani Krishnan, accounting. Funding: R. Zhang acknowledges financial support from the Social Sciences and Humanities Research Council of Canada [Grant 31-R833984]. Supplemental Material: The internet appendix and data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2024.07607 .

abstract: We test whether stablecoins and bank deposits act as substitutes by estimating the semi-elasticity of stablecoin market capitalization with respect to deposit rate changes. Using local projections fit to weekly U.S. data from January 2019 to June 2025, we find that deposit rate increases predict slower stablecoin growth. To address endogeneity, we exploit a nonlinearity in deposit rate pass-through. Whereas other money market rates track the federal funds rate roughly linearly, banksreprice deposits more aggressively once it exceeds approximately 3%. Against average ten-week stablecoin growth of 15%, ordinary least squares estimates imply a reduction of roughly 3 percentage points per basis point of deposit repricing, or about 3.75 percentage points per one-standard-deviation move. Instrumental variable estimates are roughly three times larger and pass a placebo test using non-stablecoin cryptocurrencies. Effects are stronger for USDC than for USDT, consistent with the former’s closer ties to U.S. depositors. Cross-sectional variation in repricing across deposit tiers provides independent evidence of substitution. The size of the stablecoin sector therefore depends in part on howbanks price deposits.
abstract_zh: 我们通过估计稳定币市值对存款利率变化的半弹性，检验稳定币与银行存款是否互为替代品。基于2019年1月至2025年6月美国周度数据拟合的局部投影，我们发现存款利率上升预示着稳定币增长放缓。为解决内生性问题，我们利用存款利率传导中的非线性特征。其他货币市场利率大致线性地跟随联邦基金利率，而一旦联邦基金利率超过约3%，银行对存款的重新定价则更为激进。在稳定币十周平均增长率为15%的背景下，普通最小二乘估计表明，存款重新定价每变动一个基点，稳定币增长约下降3个百分点，即每变动一个标准差约下降3.75个百分点。工具变量估计结果约为其3倍，并通过了使用非稳定币加密货币的安慰剂检验。USDC的效果强于USDT，这与前者与美国储户联系更紧密相一致。不同存款层级之间重新定价的横截面差异为替代关系提供了独立证据。因此，稳定币部门的规模部分取决于银行如何对存款定价。
title: Are stablecoins and bank deposits substitutes?
title_zh: 稳定币与银行存款是替代品吗？

abstract: L’aggravation des inégalités de revenus dans les pays occidentaux à haut revenu menace la gouvernance démocratique et la cohésion sociale, et l’intelligence artificielle risque d’aggraver encore cette situation. S’appuyant sur un ouvrage à paraître, cet article plaide en faveur des entreprises gérées par leurs salariés comme solution durable. En l’absence de propriétaires externes qui s’approprient les bénéfices, les coopératives de salariés protègent contre le pouvoir de négociation croissant des employeurs et renforcent le sentiment d’estime de soi et d’autodétermination des employés. De plus, les données suggèrent que les coopératives de travailleurs bien conçues rivalisent avec les entreprises conventionnelles sur les marchés libres, sans qu’aucun écart de productivité ne soit constaté. Comme elles sont sous-représentées sur le marché, cela nécessite une intervention des pouvoirs publics pour soutenir les coopératives de travailleurs.
title: Les entreprises gérées par leurs salariés peuvent réduire les inégalités et préserver le libre marché
title_zh: 由员工管理的企业可以减少不平等并维护自由市场

abstract: Electrification and population growth are increasing electricity demand globally. While this makes some infrastructure expansion inevitable, the extent - and cost - of this expansion, is far from inevitable. Existing infrastructure utilization is highly irregular, creating periods of significant spare capacity. If electrified appliances can concentrate their demand within these times, infrastructure expansion can be minimized. This paper presents a reference point for the scale of this opportunity with a case study of the Australian Capital Territory. It uses granular, real-world data and a simple, intuitive approach to scheduling electric vehicle charging and residential water heating. The approach builds policy-maker intuition and parallels Australian government policy that incentivizes daytime demand with three hours of free power. The results indicate that this basic approach, in principle, enables the electrification of 100% of private vehicles and water heating without exacerbating demand beyond the peak demand due to other loads, particularly space heating and cooling. Noting that practical realization of such a result is dependent on specific local context and implementation pathways, two policy implications stand out. Firstly, simple approaches for incentivizing the flexibility of electrified appliances should be acted upon immediately, as a priority; there is no need to wait for more sophisticated solutions. Examples include electricity pricing and setting appliance defaults. Secondly, concerted investment in building thermal performance is required to reduce heating and cooling demand; otherwise heating and cooling demand will drive major network upgrades, even if other electrified appliances operate flexibly.
title: Accommodating electric vehicle charging and water heating within distribution networks: a case study of the Australian Capital Territory
title_zh: 在配电网中容纳电动汽车充电和热水：澳大利亚首都地区的案例研究

abstract: This editorial introduces the special issue “FITS 2024: Financial Inclusion, FinTech, and Energy Transition for Sustainable Development.” The thirteen studies address four connected questions: how financial arrangements help households absorb shocks; how digitalization changes financial networks, asset allocation, and governance; how financial instruments and information shape firms’ environmental choices; and how forecasting and uncertainty affect investment. We position these contributions within research on financial inclusion, FinTech, climate finance, and decision-making under uncertainty. Four tensions organize the review: access versus resilience; connectivity versus fragility; financial signals versus real environmental outcomes; and predictive performance versus structural explanation. In the household studies, the consequences of inclusion depend on effective use, program scale, the shock being insured, and the surrounding institutional setting. Elsewhere in the collection, information and connectedness can improve allocation while introducing vulnerabilities and measurement problems. Policy interpretations must therefore remain consistent with the identification strategy, setting, and measured outcome. Finance enters sustainable development through several institutions, technologies, and information channels whose effects depend on design and governance.
title: Financing inclusive and sustainable transitions: Financial inclusion, FinTech, and the energy transition
title_zh: 为包容性和可持续转型融资：金融普惠、金融科技与能源转型

abstract: We conduct a survey experiment with 4000 German respondents, and provide information on two measures of gender inequality, separately or jointly: the gender gap in earnings and the gender gap in pensions. We analyse the effect of providing this information on agreement with the importance of reducing gender inequality, as well as support for policy measures targeted at different stages of the lifecycle and aimed at reducing inequality. We find that providing information on both gaps increases agreement on both accounts. Information on only one gap tends to be insignificant for preferences for policy adoption, but significant for agreement with reducing inequality. The effects of the joint treatment are comparable in magnitude to having personally experienced gender inequality. Young people respond more strongly to information about both gaps, while the single treatments are more effective for women. These individual characteristics also relate to differences in identifying the causes of gender inequality, as shown by answers to an open‐ended question.
title: Gender inequality over the lifecycle, information provision and policy preferences
title_zh: 生命周期中的性别不平等、信息提供与政策偏好

abstract: Improving environmental efficiency is critical to Africa's low-carbon development, yet the role of spatially concentrated inventive activity remains underexplored. This study examines how patent agglomeration influences environmental efficiency—and the mechanisms through which it operates—across 32 African countries over 2011–2023, using a non-radial meta-frontier DEA approach combined with dynamic panel and threshold regressions. The results show that patent agglomeration generally enhances environmental efficiency, though significant regional heterogeneity is observed, with efficiency gains concentrated in North Africa (UMA) and resource-intensive economies. Moderation analysis indicates that higher levels of knowledge-intensive activities strengthen this effect, while mediation analysis reveals that technological sophistication partially transmits agglomeration benefits. By contrast, low-carbon technology diffusion exhibits a short-run suppression effect, reflecting constraints on early-stage renewable deployment and integration. Threshold estimates further indicate that meaningful environmental gains emerge only once financial capacity and environmental regulation exceed critical levels (ln 3.015 and ln 4.051). Overall, the findings highlight the importance of aligning innovation clustering with complementary capabilities, finance, and regulatory frameworks to support low-carbon development in Africa.
title: Patent agglomeration and environmental efficiency: effects and mechanisms in Africa
title_zh: 专利集聚与环境效率：非洲的影响与机制

abstract: We assess the relative importance of three common sources of government private information in asymmetric-information models of sovereign debt: time preference, default costs, and future economic fundamentals. We develop a parsimonious signaling model that nests all three information structures and show that only private information about future fundamentals can generate a state-dependent signaling effect of sovereign borrowing on default risk. More borrowing signals stronger fundamentals when public repayment conditions are favorable, but weaker fundamentals when they are unfavorable.
title: What does sovereign borrowing signal?
title_zh: 主权借款释放了什么信号？

abstract: Agricultural support payments represent a substantial transfer from taxpayers while having considerable influence on the food system. Against a backdrop of increasing scrutiny on agricultural subsidies, devolved governments of the United Kingdom (UK) are amid the greatest policy overhaul in five decades as they reform a system of support payments previously administered under the European Union’s (EU) Common Agricultural Policy (CAP). But successful and legitimate policies require insight about the public’s preferences, for which evidence is substantially lacking. We explore public prioritisation of a large set of objectives for a future agricultural support scheme in Scotland using the Best-Worst Scaling approach and a novel modified balanced incomplete block experimental design. The survey reveals that a representative sample of the Scottish public have coherent, internally consistent visions for agricultural policy. With 92.5 % of the sample supportive of subsidies in general, the most important objective at the sample level was the production of high quality and safe food. But substantial preference heterogeneity exists; we identified three groups of citizens who backed strategies focussed on rural livelihoods, land sharing, and farm specialisation. This largely mirrors ongoing academic and policy debates around multifunctional agriculture and broad food system transformation targeting rural livelihoods and environmental objectives that map onto land sharing versus land sparing principles.
title: Hungry [f]or public Goods? What the Scottish public Demand from an agricultural support scheme
title_zh: 渴望公共物品？苏格兰公众对农业支持计划的需求

abstract: We develop a model of capital accumulation in an economy that sources investment goods from large firms with market power. We model investment-goods producers as a dynamic oligopoly and characterize the equilibrium with a dynamic markup rule. The markup on investment goods acts as an endogenous adjustment cost, which decreases as the economy grows but permanently distorts the steady state. We calibrate the model to simulate the post-2020 shocks to demand for semiconductors. The calibrated model attributes the observed increase in the price of equipment mainly to increasing marginal costs and to a smaller extent to increasing markups.
title: Investment-goods market power and capital accumulation
title_zh: 投资品市场势力与资本积累

abstract: Replication Files for ------------------------------------- -- Capturing international influences in U.S. monetary policy through a Natural Language Processing approach -- ------------------------------------- Laurent Ferrara and Nicolas de Roux ------------------------------ Contents and Replication Instructions This repository contains the replication code and dataset for the study. The current version reflects the code and data as of 2026-08-25. This replication package includes: (i) a detailed ReadMe file with step-by-step instructions for replication; (ii) a mapping of scripts to outputs, specifying which script generates each figure and table in the paper and its appendices; (iii) all datasets and source code needed to reproduce the analysis end to end, from the FOMC text corpora through sentence classification to the Taylor-rule estimations; and (iv) a test suite that checks every regenerated table cell by cell against the numbers the manuscript prints. The pipeline runs in five stages. Because the intermediate outputs are shipped - the processed corpora, the labelled sentences, the fitted classifiers and topic model, and the attention indices - the usual entry point is the last one: "uv run run_all.py --stage E" reproduces every table and figure in about five minutes. Earlier stages can be re-run individually; the ReadMe documents what each needs and how long it takes. ------------------------------ Code Annotations and System Requirements The code is extensively commented and needs no high-performance computing. The Python environment installs from a lock file with exact versions ("uv sync"); only the Taylor-rule script additionally requires R, reached through rpy2 and documented in the ReadMe. Replication runs on a standard laptop: the final stage takes about five minutes, and re-deriving everything from the raw text several hours, dominated by transcript parsing and classifier training. Shortcuts are provided so that no step is a prerequisite for those after it - cached feature matrices (1.8 MB) rebuild the classifier comparison without loading the 430 MB pretrained embedding, and cached GPT-3.5 labels remove any need for an API key. Two inputs are not redistributed. MSCI World index levels obtained through Bloomberg cannot be shared under the licence terms; a format stub and full retrieval instructions are included, and the three affected exhibits are identified in the ReadMe. The FOMC transcript PDFs (about 922 MB) are omitted for size only - the extracted text that the code actually consumes is included, and the ReadMe gives the command to re-download the PDFs.
title: Capturing international influences in U.S. monetary policy through a Natural Language Processing approach
title_zh: 通过自然语言处理方法捕捉美国货币政策中的国际影响

abstract: This study examines how firms’ affiliation with nonlocal chambers of commerce affects capital market information efficiency. Using Chinese A-share listed firms from 2007 to 2024, we find that nonlocal chamber affiliation is associated with a modest but statistically significant reduction in stock‑price synchronicity, indicating that more firm-specific information is incorporated into stock prices. This finding remains robust across alternative measures, samples, matching procedures, high-dimensional fixed effects, staggered-treatment estimators, and additional identification tests. Evidence from price delay and future earnings response coefficients further confirms that the decline in synchronicity reflects improved information incorporation rather than greater idiosyncratic noise. We further show that nonlocal chamber affiliation enhances MD&A disclosure specificity, improves disclosure quality, and increases media coverage, highlighting the role of chamber networks in strengthening firms’ external information environments. The effect is stronger among firms with weaker political connections, lower product-market competition, and stronger merchant‑guild culture, and varies with financing constraints and asset mispricing. These findings reveal how native-place business networks shape corporate information environments and stock price informativeness, extending research on informal institutions, organizational embeddedness, and capital market information efficiency in emerging markets.

title: From native-place ties to stock price informativeness: nonlocal chamber affiliation and capital market information efficiency

abstract: This paper investigates the relationship between environmental energy taxes and firm-level renewable energy adoption, addressing existing literature gaps by providing microeconomic evidence and analyzing the moderating role of institutional quality, the effectiveness of formal and informal institutions in shaping incentives and reducing uncertainty in economic interactions. Using World Bank Enterprise Survey data (2018–2020) across a large cross-country sample of firms, the empirical analysis finds that energy taxes are, on average, positively associated with firms’ renewable energy adoption, supporting the Porter Hypothesis. However, the extent of this impact depends on specific firm and country characteristics: it is significantly stronger for large corporations, as well as for firms in higher-income countries and those in environments with superior environmental performance, respectively, while remaining uniform across both manufacturing and service sectors. Additionally, energy taxation upgrades internal capabilities by stimulating R&D and strategic climate planning. Crucially, institutional quality operates through a dual pathway: it exerts a standalone direct influence that encourages firms' renewable adoption, while simultaneously acting as an indirect moderator that makes fiscal policy signals credible. The incentive effect of energy taxes is strictly contingent upon governance, becoming pronounced under higher levels of voice and accountability, control of corruption, and the rule of law. These findings carry clear policy implications, indicating that fiscal instruments and institutional reforms may need to proceed jointly, as energy taxation alone may fail to stimulate green adoption without robust institutional structures.
title: Firms’ renewable energy adoption and energy taxes: How institutional quality matters
title_zh: 企业可再生能源采用与能源税：制度质量如何发挥作用

abstract: Farmland pressure is a central issue in farmland protection and food security, yet its administrative cost to local governments, as reflected in the intensity of government overtime work, remains largely unmeasured. Matching daily night-time light data with the spatial coordinates of local government headquarters, this paper investigates the impact of farmland pressure on government overtime intensity across 300 Chinese prefecture-level cities from 2012 to 2023. Using traditional and Bartik instrumental variables and Double Machine Learning (DML) estimations, we find that rising farmland pressure significantly intensifies government overtime, robust to a series of checks. The effect is muted in large cities and regions with rich cultural endowments or lower fiscal self-sufficiency. Mechanism tests show that farmland pressure drives bureaucratic overwork through increased public service provision, intensified environmental governance mandates, and expanded land allocation quotas. We conclude with policy implications for appraisal reform, governance tools, and civil servants’ well-being.

title: Sleepless governments under the land dilemma: farmland pressure and overtime work of local governments

abstract: China’s innovative capacity has expanded rapidly. I examine whether trade substitution towards China strengthens its influence on subsequent innovation abroad. To study this possibility, I exploit the 2011 Tōhoku earthquake, which abruptly disrupted pre-existing supply relationships with Japan. I use patent-text similarity to capture one dimension of this influence. Specifically, I compare abstracts from 1.43 million foreign USPTO patent applications filed during 2008–2020 with prior-year Chinese patent abstracts in the same IPC subclass. Following the earthquake, foreign patent abstracts in technology fields with greater predetermined exposure to Japan became significantly more similar to recent Chinese patent text. This result is robust to alternative exposure measures, timing definitions, trend controls, patent-quality adjustments, and inventor-location restrictions. Complementary product-level trade estimates show that greater pre-earthquake dependence on Japan predicts lower imports from Japan and higher imports from China, consistent with partial substitution towards China. Taken together, the findings suggest that supply-chain adjustment may be one channel through which Chinese innovation affects subsequent innovation abroad. Trade and innovation policy should therefore not be treated as entirely separate domains.

title: Trade substitution and similarity to Chinese patent text: evidence from USPTO patents
title_zh: 贸易替代与中国专利文本的相似性：来自USPTO专利的证据

abstract: Under the dual challenges of global climate change and energy crises, the success of energy transition critically depends on substantive citizen engagement to secure social legitimacy and mobilize distributed resources. However, encouraging such engagement requires moving beyond mere material incentives to resonate with citizens' normative values. This study investigates how energy justice framed policy narratives serve as a key communicative mechanism to foster citizens' willingness to contribute time and capital. Based on a survey experiment with 927 participants, the study designed three narratives reflecting distributional, procedural, and recognition justice compared against a control group. The experimental results indicate that justice-framed narratives can significantly enhance citizens’ policy support, thereby promoting willingness to contribute time and capital, with the rights protection narrative representing procedural justice being the most prominent. Moreover, the effects of different justice-framed policy narratives also vary among citizens with different levels of trust in the government. This study advances the theoretical discourse on just energy transition by elucidating the roles of policy narratives, while offering practical insights to guide governmental communication strategies that foster citizen engagement and promote a just and sustainable energy transition.
title: How justice-framed policy narratives shape citizen engagement: Evidence from a survey experiment on time and capital contributions
title_zh: 以公正为框架的政策叙事如何影响公民参与：来自时间和资本贡献调查实验的证据

abstract: We examine how private foundations allocate charitable capital in response to recipient need. Using financial shocks to peer foundations (who fund the same recipients), we isolate exogenous changes in the marginal value of grants. Foundations respond to need by reallocating grants across recipients, particularly for scientific causes and longer donor–recipient relationships. However, their annual grantmaking budgets show little intertemporal flexibility, instead prioritizing capital preservation. Among governance characteristics, founder involvement predicts both cross-sectional responsiveness and intertemporal conservatism. Our findings highlight a tension: founders’ charitable intent supports effective allocation, but their inclination toward capital preservation can hinder impact maximization.
title: Charitable capital allocation: Evidence from private foundations
title_zh: 慈善资本配置：来自私人基金会的证据

abstract: Prevailing theories of financial intermediation assume an integrated financial sector with frictionless risk‐sharing. However, we identify substantial risk‐sharing frictions linked to intermediary specialization using currency derivatives markets as a laboratory. Using confidential supervisory data covering $25 trillion in daily bank exposures, we document imperfect hedging in banks' FX‐swap intermediation: banks rarely hedge their synthetic dollar lending with maturity‐matched foreign safe assets. Intermediaries specialize in markets in which they have expertise in managing the associated exposures, giving rise to cross‐market variation in deviations from covered‐interest parity. Our results highlight the importance of intermediary specialization and its impact on risk premia.
title: Risk, Specialization, and Covered‐Interest Parity
title_zh: 风险、专业化与抛补利率平价

abstract: Weather shocks can constrain educational investment and human capital formation. In Qing China, education spending rose and fell with weather-sensitive farm income. Using a two-century panel (1646–1904) covering 234 prefectures, we find that a drought occurring one year before the examinations and additional droughts within the past five years reduce jinshi (the highest degree in the imperial examination system) density by approximately 6 % and 2.6 % per period, respectively. Adaptive measures such as the introduction of sweet potatoes, savings from surplus years, and flexible pricing mechanisms prove effective in mitigating drought effects. For robustness, we proxy regional recording capacity with the word count of meteorological entries and augment the baseline with controls for social unrest and epidemic shocks, with results remaining stable. By bringing long-run historical evidence to bear, this study enriches the literature on how extreme weather affects human capital formation.

abstract: Consider aggregate choice data from a population with heterogeneity in both preferences (or more general decision rules) and in menus, and where the analyst has limited information about how menus are distributed across the population. We determine what can be inferred from aggregate data about the distribution of preferences by identifying the set of all distributions that are consistent with the preceding. Our main theorem strengthens and generalizes existing results on such identification and provides an alternative analytical approach (using convex capacities) to study the problem.
journal: Journal of Economic Behavior and Organization
source_issue: Journal of Economic Behavior & Organization, Volume 251
title: Identifying heterogeneous decision rules from choices when menus are unobserved
title_zh: 在菜单不可观测时从选择中识别异质性决策规则

abstract: Managing grasslands for both carbon sequestration and biodiversity conservation is increasingly challenging under climate change. We develop an integrated climate–ecological–economic modelling framework to evaluate biodiversity–carbon trade-offs in the Inner Mongolian typical steppe, where mowing and grazing are dominant management practices. Using butterflies as biodiversity indicators, carbon-sequestration estimates, regional opportunity-cost parameters, and downscaled climate projections under SSP1–2.6, SSP2–4.5, and SSP5–8.5, we applied the Non-dominated Sorting Genetic Algorithm II (NSGA-II) to identify Pareto-optimal mowing–grazing configurations from 2025 to 2050. The simulations indicated that, within the parameterized water-limited response functions, projected precipitation differences were associated with larger shifts in biodiversity–carbon co-management potential than temperature differences. Under the assumptions of our modelling framework, optimized configurations were generally mowing-dominated, with mowing accounting for 77%–94% of the management-allocation matrix in representative 2030 solutions, although grazing-oriented patches remained important in biodiversity-priority outcomes by maintaining habitat heterogeneity. Opportunity-cost accounting provided a regional economic comparison layer for Pareto-optimal configurations, with temporal cost increases mainly reflecting the assumed annual escalation and cross-scenario differences reflecting the cost ranges of feasible Pareto-optimal solutions. Overall, the framework provides a transferable approach for linking climate scenarios, land-use allocation, ecological outcomes, and economic constraints in grassland biodiversity–carbon co-management, subject to recalibration with local ecological, management, and economic parameters.
title: Optimizing grassland biodiversity and carbon co-benefits under climate change: An integrated climate-ecological-economic modelling framework
title_zh: 优化气候变化下的草地生物多样性与碳协同效益：一个气候-生态-经济综合建模框架

abstract: Explaining comparative economic development requires identifying the causes of institutional change. This column uses AI to analyse 120 years of newspaper coverage and produce a new index of uncertainty about a country's core institutions. In the countries studied, nearly every major shift in democracy happened when this index was high. Because it detects slow-building uncertainty that other risk measures miss, the index could serve as an early warning of institutional fragility.
authors: Michael Callen, Gregory Levy, Saipremnath Muthukumaran, Jonathan Weigel, Noam Yuchtman
title: Detecting institutional change as it unfolds: Evidence from 120 years of reporting
title_zh: 检测制度变迁的展开过程：来自120年报道的证据

abstract: Green innovation is central for the transition to a low-carbon economy, but there are concerns that economic downturns may slow technological progress by reducing firms’ incentives and resources to innovate. This column shows that green and non-green innovation respond very differently to the business cycle. While non-green innovation declines after contractionary shocks, green innovation increases. A model of directed technical change explains this divergence through the more backloaded profits of green technologies and the reallocation of scarce innovation inputs during downturns. The findings imply that R&D subsidies are more effective – and generate relatively more green innovation – during downturns.
authors: Diego Känzig, Maximilian Konradt, Lixing Wang, Donghai Zhang
china_relevance_reason: 研究主题为经济衰退与绿色创新的关系，未涉及中国的研究对象、数据或制度背景。
title: Why downturns can make innovation greener
title_zh: 为何经济衰退能使创新更绿色

abstract: Public services increasingly use predictive algorithms to direct scarce support towards those most at risk. But are these also the people who benefit most from intervention? This column explains how to navigate this trade-off and shows why it matters in practice. Job search counselling gets people into work faster, but has little effect on those at greatest risk of long-term unemployment. Combining predictions of risk and responsiveness can make scarce support substantially more effective, while highlighting the need for different support for those hardest to help.
authors: Sebastian Ernst, Andreas I. Mueller, Johannes Spinnewijn
title: At risk or responsive: Rethinking unemployment policy
title_zh: 面临风险还是积极回应：反思失业政策

abstract: Although many studies have analyzed the drivers and impact of foreign direct investment, less is known about its determinants at different stages of the investment planning and implementation cycle. Meanwhile, researchers are increasingly relying on data tracking announcements of FDI projects, rather than traditional balance-of-payments information, which reflects actual investments. What share of announced projects is completed, and what factors can derail an investment’s progress after a decision is announced? This paper examines the implementation outcomes of all large announced greenfield FDI projects in low-income countries between 2011 and 2020 and explores some of the factors associated with greater likelihood of implementation. It finds that less than half of the projects in the sample were completed or remained on track. Implementation outcomes vary considerably across sectors and source countries. Based on a systematic analysis of publicly available information reported by companies and the media, the most frequently reported barriers to project realization seem to be policy, regulatory, and administrative constraints, as well as financing difficulties and investor-related challenges. Moreover, econometric results indicate that stronger post-announcement economic growth increases the likelihood of project completion, whereas larger projects are less likely to become operational. Among completed projects, the average time from announcement to operation is about three years; timelines vary across business activities but show little relationship with project size.
abstract_zh: 尽管已有大量研究分析了外国直接投资的驱动因素及其影响，但对其在投资规划与实施周期不同阶段的决定因素仍知之甚少。与此同时，研究者日益依赖追踪外国直接投资项目公告的数据，而非反映实际投资的传统国际收支信息。已公告项目中究竟有多大比例最终完成？哪些因素可能在投资决策公布后阻碍项目推进？本文考察了2011年至2020年间低收入国家所有大型已公告绿地外国直接投资项目的实施结果，并探讨了与更高实施可能性相关的一些因素。研究发现，样本中不到一半的项目已完成或仍按计划推进。实施结果在不同行业和来源国之间差异显著。基于对公司及媒体公开信息的系统分析，项目落地最常被报告的障碍似乎是政策、监管和行政约束，以及融资困难和与投资者相关的挑战。此外，计量经济学结果表明，公告后更强的经济增长会提高项目完成的可能性，而规模较大的项目则更不可能投入运营。在已完成的项目中，从公告到运营的平均时间约为三年；这一时间线因业务活动而异，但与项目规模关系不大。
journal: World Bank Policy Research Working Papers
publisher: World Bank Policy Research Working Papers
series: World Bank Policy Research Working Papers
source_name: World Bank Policy Research Working Papers
title: From Announcement to Completion: Tracking Big FDI Projects in LICs
title_zh: 从宣布到完成：追踪低收入国家的重大外商直接投资项目

abstract: Uzbekistan is advancing a comprehensive package of market-oriented reforms as part of its World Trade Organization accession strategy, including the abolition of monopolies, trade liberalization (removal of a range of export-related subsidies and tax incentives), the elimination of domestic producer preferences in public procurement, and an anticipated rise in foreign direct investment. This paper evaluates the macroeconomic and distributional impacts of reforms using an integrated computable general equilibrium–microsimulation framework that combines the World Bank’s MANAGE-WB model with household-level data from the 2024 Uzbekistan Household Budget Survey. The results show that the coordinated reform package generates substantial efficiency gains, raising annual gross domestic product growth by approximately 1.0 percentage point above a 5.8 percent baseline between 2025 and 2040, with an additional 0.4 percentage point gain when complemented by a foreign direct investment boost. Consumer prices fall cumulatively by up to 19.5 percent, and welfare improvements are driven primarily through enhanced purchasing power rather than nominal wage increases. The abolition of monopolies emerges as the dominant macroeconomic driver, while trade liberalization sustains long-term productivity growth and the removal of procurement preferences plays a complementary role. These gains are uneven across groups including gender, sectors, and location, and gender wage gaps remain largely unchanged. The findings underscore the importance of complementarities between competition policy, trade liberalization, and foreign direct investment promotion, as well as the need for targeted human capital, labor mobility, and social protection policies to ensure that reforms translate into broadly inclusive outcomes.
abstract_zh: 乌兹别克斯坦正在推进一揽子全面的市场化改革，作为其加入世界贸易组织战略的一部分，包括废除垄断、贸易自由化（取消一系列与出口相关的补贴和税收优惠）、消除公共采购中对国内生产者的优惠，以及预期中的外国直接投资增长。本文采用一个整合的可计算一般均衡—微观模拟框架，将世界银行的MANAGE-WB模型与2024年乌兹别克斯坦家庭预算调查的住户层面数据相结合，评估改革的宏观经济与分配影响。结果表明，协调推进的改革方案产生了显著的效率收益，在2025年至2040年间，使年度国内生产总值增长率较5.8%的基线水平提高约1.0个百分点；若辅以外国直接投资提振，还可额外提高0.4个百分点。消费者价格累计下降幅度最高达19.5%，福利改善主要通过增强购买力而非名义工资增长来实现。废除垄断成为主导性的宏观经济驱动因素，而贸易自由化支撑长期生产率增长，取消采购优惠则发挥补充作用。这些收益在包括性别、部门和地区在内的不同群体之间分布不均，性别工资差距基本未发生变化。研究结果凸显了竞争政策、贸易自由化和外国直接投资促进之间互补性的重要性，同时也表明需要采取有针对性的人力资本、劳动力流动和社会保护政策，以确保改革转化为广泛包容的成果。
china_relevance_reason: 研究对象为乌兹别克斯坦的市场化改革，数据与制度背景均为乌兹别克斯坦，与中国无关。
journal: World Bank Policy Research Working Papers
publisher: World Bank Policy Research Working Papers
series: World Bank Policy Research Working Papers
source_name: World Bank Policy Research Working Papers
title: Distributional Effects of Market-Oriented Reforms in Uzbekistan: A Macro-Micro Simulation Approach
title_zh: 乌兹别克斯坦市场化改革的分配效应：宏观-微观模拟方法

abstract: How do high public debt and fiscal uncertainty interact to shape inflation? We develop a model in which firms face uncertainty about both marginal costs and fiscal policy and choose how much information to acquire before setting prices. Higher debt raises steady-state taxes, affecting attention through two opposing forces. While these taxes reduce the profit stakes of mispricing, they make desired prices more sensitive to tax fluctuations, increasing the value of information. The interaction generates a U-shaped relationship between public debt and attention, and therefore between debt and inflation volatility. Using euro-area firm-level expectations data, we document that the passthrough of expected input-cost growth into expected selling-price growth rises systematically with a country's debt-to-GDP ratio, consistent with the model. In the calibrated general-equilibrium model, an increase in debt from 100% to 175% of GDP raises inflation volatility by about 20%, mainly because firms reallocate attention toward fiscal shocks.
title: Inattentive Price Setting and Inflation Under Fiscal Policy Uncertainty
title_zh: 财政政策不确定性下的疏忽定价与通货膨胀
